text:
maya: Planning deploy for model-routing change today 17:00 PT. Deploy owner @vikram. Need: who owns smoke checks, confirm rollback criteria, and runbook quick sanity. Ping owners.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment 'model-routing-v2' at 2026-03-17T17:00:00-07:00 by @vikram. CI green. :rocket:

vikram: I'll do the deploy. Smoke checks: routing correctness, latency < 120ms p95, error-rate < 0.5%. @qa-lead can you run smoke scripts?

qa-lead: On it. Smoke scripts: `smoke/routing_smoke.sh` — will run after canary. ETA 10min. Will post results here.

samir: Are there any schema/db changes? Need migration window? :thinking_face:

maya: No DB changes. Pure traffic split config & configmap change. Rollback is config revert + pin model to v1.

alvaro: For rollback triggers I'd add: 1) sustained p95 > 200ms for 5m, 2) error-rate > 1% for 3m, 3) bad outputs spike (user reports). Agree? :+1:

jen: Agree. Also add 'significant decrease in throughput for dedicated customers' as trigger.

vikram: Rollback steps in runbook: ```
- Abort canary
- apply: kubectl apply -f releases/model-routing-v1.yaml
- clear cache: /scripts/clear_kv_cache.sh
- monitor metrics for 10m
``` I'll paste full runbook link.

vikram: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploys/model-routing (please don't share externally) — section 'quick revert' has exact commands.

qa-lead: Smoke run results: routing checks pass, latency p95 78ms, error-rate 0.12%, sample outputs look good. Posting logs snippet: ```200 OK - sample routing logs...```

maya: Great. Owners: @vikram deploy, @qa-lead smoke, @alvaro monitor infra, @jen customer comms. Go/no-go at 16:45 PT? We'll call here.

alvaro: :eyes: I'll be monitoring dashboards. Alerting set: p95 != baseline, error-rate alert to #eng-sre

samir: If rollback needed, who runs it? I can execute if vikram unavailable.

vikram: If I'm offline, @samir or @alvaro have perms. I'll handoff in 10.

deploy-bot: Canary started: 10% traffic -> model-routing-v2. CI tag: build-20260317-88. Notifying metrics channel.

qa-lead: Canary smoke: OK. No regressions in samples. Proceeding to ramp to 50%.

maya: Thanks all. Final check: any blockers? Otherwise we'll proceed per plan. :white_check_mark:

jen: No blockers. Preparing customer note template.
